create.title: Create Room
create.help: Set up the house rules, then share the code with your friends.

join.title: Join Room
join.help: Enter the 6-character code your friend shared.
join.linkHint: Got a link? Just open it — it joins the room directly.

settings.strictHelp: you must beat the highest card when trump is led or in All Trumps, and overtrump an opponent's trump when you are void in the led suit.
settings.relaxedHelp: you only have to follow suit; when void and an opponent holds the trick you must play any trump — no obligation to beat or overtrump.
settings.manualHelp: Nothing is declared automatically: use the Announce and Belot buttons when playing your first card.
settings.autoHelp: Combinations (Tierce, Fifty, Hundred, Carre) and Belot are declared automatically.

difficultyHelp.easy: plays legal but mostly random cards and misses tactics. Good for learning.
difficultyHelp.medium: follows standard strategy: covers partner, trumps sensibly and tracks high cards.
difficultyHelp.hard: counts cards and reads voids and partner signals. Bots never see hidden cards.
